canonical_statement: For every type alpha, there exists a binary relation on alpha which is well-founded and trichotomous, hence a strict well-order.
domain_and_universes: universe u; alpha : Type u; the relation alpha -> alpha -> Prop and its IsWellOrder witness are universe-polymorphic; the complete declaration is a Prop.
conclusion: Nonempty { r : alpha -> alpha -> Prop // IsWellOrder alpha r }
minimal_import_evidence: The canonical statement, IsWellOrder, WellFoundedLT, IsWellOrder.linearOrder, and the reverse LinearOrder instance are all exposed by Mathlib.Order.RelClasses. The cardinal construction and exists_wellOrder proof module are deliberately not imported at this phase.

foundation_profile.target: A proposition only; no inhabitant or well-ordering construction is supplied here.

killed: removed well-foundedness by retaining only IsStrictTotalOrder
removed linearity by retaining only IsWellFounded
restricted the carrier domain to inhabited types
replaced the universally quantified carrier with Nat

degenerate_cases: No carrier is excluded. Empty and singleton carriers are kernel-checked fixtures; finite and infinite carriers remain under the same universal binder.
status_boundary: This freezes and elaborates the exact relation-level target and its bundled-order equivalence only. It does not import or credit exists_wellOrder, audit proof provenance, establish M0, or complete the theorem.
